description:
SOX Contractor – Service Provider & SOC 1 Reviews
Location: Houston, Texas (On-site)
 

Role Overview
This organization is seeking a qualified SOX Contractor to support the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Program. The successful candidate will assume primary responsibility for performing and documenting reviews of third-party service providers that impact internal control over financial reporting (ICFR). This position evaluates SOC 1 reports and related documentation to determine whether service-provider controls adequately address relevant financial reporting risks, and identifies whether additional controls or follow-up procedures are required.
